# swiftlang/swift#94511: on Linux, ThreadSanitizer cannot see the acquire in
# Synchronization.Mutex's non-inlined slow path (`_lockSlow`, plain-futex),
# so it reports false races between withLock bodies on contended Mutexes.
# All frames below are accesses inside the same Mutex.withLock and are false
# positives. Remove these entries once the toolchain includes the upstream
# fix, swiftlang/swift#94425 (and its XFAIL test, swiftlang/swift#94307).
race:fulfillSuccess
race:awaitReady
race:bindOwnerThread
race:requireOwnerThread
